# routeros_queue_interface (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_queue_interface" "interface" {
  interface = "ether1"
  queue     = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface whose automatically created queue entry is managed.
- `queue` (String) Name of the `/queue/type` entry applied to the interface, for example `only-hardware-queue`, `ethernet-default` or `no-queue`.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>

### Read-Only

- `active_queue` (String) Queue type that is actually applied to the interface at the moment.
- `default_queue` (String) Queue type the interface driver reports as its default.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/queue/interface get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_queue_interface.interface "*1"
```
